owner: Authenticated opaque account generation; never a username/client-selected owner
history: One current full JSON snapshot per owner; IndexedDB readwrite transaction atomic. UTF8 sha256/byte length stored beside raw. localStorage pointer names owner/kind/key; fixed history key points to current atomic snapshot, NOT immutable content hash. Saves serialized in call order; old inline history stays until successful pointer write. No bulk migration.
pending: New full payload JSON immutable by owner:payload:sha256; localStorage contains owner/request/conversation/phase/attempted and reference. Legacy inline entries continue working. Full readback+hash+bytes and account/request_id checked before POST.
ordering: Snapshot history; wait transaction.oncomplete and verify readback; publish small pointer.
Persist full body; wait commit and readback; publish outbox metadata.
Negotiate authenticated session; hydrate exact original payload; prepare bytes.
Persist attempted=true and verify BEFORE POST.
Once attempted, recovery uses GET with same request_id; NEVER POST again automatically, even with missing payload storage.
Complete response must be durably saved before phase=saved and ACK. Delete pending payload only after server ACK and local metadata removal.
failure: Visible refusal on missing/corrupt ref, unavailable IDB, blocked/error/abort/readback, quota or account switch. No dropping content, no partial ACK, no fallback after uncertain POST.
cleanup: One current history per owner; payload cleanup after ACK only; failed pre-metadata commits may leave orphan blobs; no opportunistic GC in this minimal patch. Account exclusion purges own prefix and verifies no keys remain; failures visible. No cross-account deletion.
unchanged: JSON transport/envelope, wire cap20MiB, image byte limit8,000,000, attachment count and document policies

client_merge: Apply repair storage logic then waiting R2 server-refusal+indicator patch by reviewed merge. This repair intentionally does not change the server refusal rendering conditional; local notSubmitted notice belongs to repair. No overwrite of waiting stage.
validation_limits: Node VM simulated IndexedDB, not real WebKit. Browser harness prepared; local headless executables emitted no result. iPhone physical test required after parent approval; not performed here.
